images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with strict identity and scene preservation. IMAGE 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET: an original wildlife photograph supplied by the user. IMAGE 2 is ONLY the approved COLOR / INSTANT FILM TEXTURE reference, never a source of subject, pose, composition or scenery. Apply the same gentle realistic instant-color film treatment from image 2 to image 1. Output exactly ONE standalone landscape photograph, full bleed edge-to-edge, no border or white paper, no labels, no text, no montage, no UI, no watermark. Preserve IMAGE 1 entire original composition, framing and aspect ratio; do not crop to a square or zoom. Preserve its exact individual muskrat, anatomy, fur silhouette, small eyes, muzzle, mouth, paws, whiskers, tail when visible, position in frame, activity, reeds/leaves/stems, water surface structure, original lighting direction and reflections. Do not invent detail, substitute another animal, move eyes or paws, open/close mouth, remove/add objects or transplant the scene from image 2. This is photographic grading/texture only. STYLE: moderately deep but legible shadows, subtle cool blue-gray shadow tone with no pronounced purple, natural warm brown fur, nuanced restrained greens, soften excessively electric digital cyan/blue into rich but gentle film-like water color, smooth creamy highlight rolloff with detail retained, subtle optical softness to reduce digital edge harshness but keep eyes and animal features clear, fine stable organic film grain, delicate unobtrusive corner shading. Clean fresh instant-photo character matching the approved mild reference, NOT damaged vintage film, NOT intensified experimental treatment. No heavy vignette, scratched paper, orange leaks, streaks, bloom fog, unrealistic rim lighting, brushstrokes, illustration, heavy chromatic aberration, dramatic recoloring or yellow tint. Keep color differences between animal and environment. No fake shallow depth of field or replacement background. Treat whole scene consistently with its original natural light. Preserve photography, avoid AI-polished synthetic fur or extra sharpness. Produce high-resolution output with original landscape aspect ratio.

Keep this exact close framing and the existing bright open blue water setting. Natural warm brown fur; water graded softer and slightly cooler/deeper without darkening whole image into night. Full original view retained.
